purpose: Directed equivalence check after excluding Task 011 report/artifacts from Tailwind utility scanning; no browser or performance rerun is claimed.

buildIds.provenance: Each Build ID was parsed from the root RSC __next._tree.txt 0-record b property and independently matched to the unique _next/static/<id>/_buildManifest.js directory.

normalizationPolicy.paths: Only the exact independently extracted Build ID component in _next/static/<BUILD_ID>/ manifest paths.
normalizationPolicy.payloads: Only the full exact JSON property token "b":"<known id>" in plain RSC, or the corresponding escaped Flight JSON token in HTML. No arbitrary string stripping, regex content removal, whitespace changes or asset-body normalization.
normalizationPolicy.assetBytes: All CSS, JavaScript including relocated manifests, fonts, icons and public artwork bytes must match raw.

sourceExclusionChange.effect: Current compiled CSS is raw byte-identical to the tested artifact; the source directives exclude report/evidence text from utility generation.

conclusion: All 204 files have equivalent logical paths and content. Runtime asset bodies are raw byte-identical; HTML/RSC differences are exclusively the validated build identity fields. This bridge supports preservation of the tested rendered runtime after the build-only Tailwind source exclusion.
limits: The comparison is against the captured current artifact and preserved tested copy, not a future rebuild or deployed CI artifact.
No browser, full specification reread, font decoding, Lighthouse or new performance measurement was performed.
Performance timings and previous visual/functional reviews remain the original evidence; this is an artifact identity bridge and does not restate them as newly executed.
